title: Local multiplayer: shared keyboard and hot seat turns
when: Two to four people play on one device, either at the same time with split keyboard zones and gamepads, or taking turns with a pass the device screen between turns.
prompt:
Goal: Fair simultaneous play on shared hardware, and clean turn handoffs that hide private information.
Steps:
1. Player slots: players[i] = { name, color, shape, device } where device is "keys-left" (WASD plus F and G), "keys-right" (arrows plus K and L) or a gamepad index.
2. Join screen: each person presses any button on their device to claim the next slot; the slot shows color plus shape for colorblind players.
3. Keyboards drop some key combinations (ghosting); keep the zones far apart and test with both players holding three keys.
4. The input layer answers per player: input.isDown(playerIndex, "fire").
5. Hot seat: a turn order array and a handoff screen "Pass to Ana" that hides secret hands until a Ready button is pressed.
6. An optional turn timer pauses on the handoff screen; announce the active player in an aria-live region.
7. A HUD row shows each score; a rematch keeps names and rotates who starts.
8. Save the turn match state in guarded localStorage so a closed tab can resume.
Quality bar:
- Both players control at once without stealing input from each other.
- A hot seat player never sees the other hand during a handoff.
Pitfalls:
- Bindings packed into one keyboard row, which ghost.
- One global key Set without per player mapping.
- The same player always starting, which is unfair.
Verify:
- [ ] Three keys per player held together all register.
- [ ] The handoff screen covers private information.
- [ ] Reloading resumes the current turn.
Output: js/players.js, js/hotseat.js and the join and handoff screens in index.html.

examples.input: two players on the same keyboard, and a pass and play mode
examples.output: device slots with join screen, per player input, ghosting safe zones, handoff screen, saved turns
